mentions.name: ShredBlocks
mentions.description: An iOS app for metronome sequencing aimed at guitar speed training. It lets players chain blocks with different tempos, time signatures, and subdivisions into a single practice sequence, with planned accuracy indicators and scoring so rushing or dragging can be identified from post-routine metrics on saved routines. It applies a speed-building method of pushing tempo past a plateau and dialing back, as a simpler hobbyist alternative to a DAW.
mentions.problem: Intermediate guitarists commonly stagnate into a plateau at a certain BPM, and existing tools don't provide a simple way to customize variable, sequence-based metronome practice for building speed.
mentions.audience: Intermediate guitarists stuck at a speed plateau who want a simple, variable way to customize metronome practice sessions without using a DAW
mentions.source_excerpt: Building an iOS app for metronome sequencing to get faster at playing guitar and reaching "shred" speeds at different subdivisions/time signatures in a single sequence. Planning on adding accuracy indicators and scoring so rushing or dragging can be easily identified when finishing a saved routine.
